text:
anita: Monthly recurrence review: extracted top 5 signatures (R1..R5). Thread to lock owners, timelines, ACs. I uploaded the scan CSV to the tracker.

mike: I'll take R2 and R5. R2 impacts latency spikes.

ravi: I can take R3. For R1 I need infra kernel backport approval (PR 5771)  blocked.

emily: I'll own R4 long-term and help with R2 mitigations this week.

incident-bot: Automated scan summary: run=2026-03-12; recurrences=22; signatures=[R1,R2,R3,R4,R5]; follow-ups created: PM-1101..PM-1103.

anita: Action: update the incident tracker: owner | ticket | ETA | AC | fallback. Put realistic ETAs (avoid optimistic).

mike: Short-term for R2: tune router circuit and pin model version. Commands I used in staging:

```
rgctl routes set --route model-router --circuit 80 --window 30
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/models/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"r2-v1"}'
```

mike: Staging smoke: 3h run, no recurrence. I'll run a 24h test tonight and post results.

ravi: @infra-team can we get status on PR 5771? This blocks R1's remediation.

emily: R4 long-term requires CAP-8804 (extra node group). Filed CAP-8804; awaiting capacity review. Fallback is QoS throttling with higher latency.

anita: Good. Please ensure each ticket includes acceptance criteria. Example AC: "<10 errors/day and no customer-facing latency spikes >500ms for 14d" and monitoring query attached.

incident-bot: Reminder: add monitoring queries for recurrence detection. Example query: `increase(errors_total{sig=\"R2\"}[1d]) > 5`.

mike: Added owners and ETAs in tracker: R2 short-term ETA 7d (P0), R5 ETA 3w (P1).

ravi: Infra replied: PR 5771 under review, ETA Tue EOD. If delayed, fallback is kernel config parameter tweak (less ideal).

emily: I'll draft the R4 rollout plan with canary percentages and automatic fallback.

anita: Weekly follow-ups: who will post status?

mike: I'll post the weekly status on Fridays.

incident-bot: Closing note: owners must update tracker when blockers appear and tag infra/capacity. Next monthly review scheduled in 30 days.

anita: Thanks team. If blockers remain on Tue, we'll escalate in the Wed ops huddle. :raised_hands:
